(declare-sort SourceDeclaration 0)
(declare-fun selected () SourceDeclaration)
(declare-fun originalDecode (Int) SourceDeclaration)
(declare-fun inverse (Int) Int)
(declare-fun permutation (Int) Int)
(declare-fun originalIndex (SourceDeclaration) Int)
(assert (let ((a!1 (forall ((arbitrary SourceDeclaration))
             (= (originalDecode (originalIndex arbitrary)) arbitrary)))
      (a!2 (forall ((position Int))
             (= (inverse (permutation position)) position)))
      (a!3 (originalDecode (inverse (permutation (originalIndex selected))))))
  (and a!1 a!2 (distinct a!3 selected))))
queries.scope: Arbitrary declaration domain and integer index; assumes exact original lookup and inverse rebasing. Not implementation refinement.
